name: Bloodthirsty Arrow
description: Fills the arrow with a thirst for blood: for each mote spent, either subtract one die from the target's first defensive action (not below her Essence) or add one die to the attack's damage against a living target (not more than the Abyssal's permanent Essence). Both effects may be used at once.

name: Twisting Spiteful Shaft
description: The arrow adds the character's permanent Essence to its base damage, then keeps boring: after impact it inflicts its normal damage modifier again at the start of each subsequent turn (min one die), up to Essence turns, until pulled free by a Strength + Athletics roll (difficulty = Essence, max 5). Boring damage is soaked only by natural soak. Only lethal-damage arrows qualify.

name: Hundred Paces Bite
description: The arrow becomes a conduit for the life-draining anima: the Exalt regains one mote of Essence per health level of damage the arrow inflicts on a living target. Comboed with Twisting Spiteful Shaft its cost rises to 3 motes but it keeps absorbing Essence as the arrow burrows.

name: Pulse of the Prey
description: Attunes the archer's gaze to the Essence-glow in a victim: for 3 motes he makes an Archery attack with no penalty for visual conditions, and for each extra mote adds a die to the roll (not more than the target's Essence). Does not aid targeting inanimate objects.

name: Flawless Archer Discipline
description: The Abyssal blocks out all distraction; the attack still rolls, but successes matter only for damage — even on a botch the arrow hits and inflicts its base damage. Permits feats of impossible accuracy but does not allow called shots to bypass armor.

name: Withering Feathered Maelstrom
description: The Abyssal empties her quiver in a blur: so long as she hits her intended target she keeps making attacks at her full Archery pool, all against one target, until she runs out of ammunition or has done damage a number of times equal to her Archery score.

name: Iron Sleet Attack
description: The arrow freezes with the chill of the Void, adding the character's Essence to its damage and inflicting frostbite: each time it damages a target, that target loses one dot of Dexterity (regained at one dot per hour). No effect on the undead or beings immune to extreme cold.

name: Relic Arrow Method
description: A savagely barbed shaft materializes under the archer's touch. Arrows made this way have normal statistics for their type but shimmer like spun glass and evaporate moments after impact.

name: Splinter of the Void
description: Draws a bolt of crackling Oblivion, fired as a normal arrow with base damage 2L per mote spent (the bow does not add). Against Fair Folk, mutants and other Wyld creatures the damage is aggravated; those slain disintegrate and leave no ghost. Ignores distance and wind penalties, max range Essence×100 yards. Incompatible with arrow-enhancing Charms.

name: Exquisite Relic Bow
description: Summons a bow of calcified Essence and memory with Accuracy equal to the character's Essence, otherwise statted as a composite bow fitted to her Strength. It manifests no ammunition, so the archer must supply arrows or use Relic Arrow Method.

name: Piercing Ghost Barb
description: Combines the barrow-flame of the Void with the archer's deadly focus to fire a bolt that pierces the soul as well as the body.
